Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of the year y.
Participant(x, y) ::: x participated in the year y.
LeaderboardTie(x, y) ::: There was a y-way tie on the leaderboard and x is in the tie.
FromCountry(x, y) ::: x is from country y.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of the year y.
AllOnLeaderboardParticipated(y) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the year y participated.
Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, 1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participant(steinhauer, 1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
LeaderboardTie(six, 1992) ∧ FromCountry(descampe, belgium) ∧ FromCountry(y, belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, 1992) ∧ OnLeaderboard(y, 1992) ∧ OnLeaderboard(z, 1992) ∧ OnLeaderboard(w, 1992) ∧ OnLeaderboard(v, 1992) ∧ OnLeaderboard(u, 1992) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium. Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, 1992) → Participant(x, 1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
LeaderboardTie(descampe, 1992) ::: Descampe is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
